verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a first-party claim that conversations, settings, and subscription sync "across every platform". That implies multiple official clients, but it never names iOS or Android apps or describes what they can do. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official iOS and Android apps, evidence those apps are full-featured (connectors, voice, Imagine, workspaces on mobile), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
